scope: 62 distinct main-bank question IDs in six bounded AI semantic groups; not whole-sector acceptance. Preserves q222 and prior arithmetic/image evidence.

groups.method: AI read Japanese stem, all four options, keyed answer and explanation, compared Vietnamese stem/options/explanation. No external factual thresholds changed.

results.semanticCheck: Stem specifies cooking and serving hot; heated category is unique; other choices say unheated/frozen or deny stated process.
Simmering in seasoned liquid matches flavor absorption; other choices describe searing, frying or steaming.
Japanese wording is retained in VI; keyed amount receipt avoids extraneous kara, while other alternatives change construction/meaning.
Additional cooling step requires temperature/time control; alternative choices omit measurement or recording.
Steam heat explains heating liquid inside a vessel; ice/direct flame/oil do not describe steaming.
Full product name is appropriate customer confirmation; alternatives impose internal shorthand or refuse service.
Washing reduces adhering contamination; no claim of sterilization or permission for ambient holding is made.
Hot steam is the stated burn hazard; alternatives approach steam or omit precautions.
Casual versus humble Japanese register is the keyed distinction; repaired VI now preserves both exact Japanese phrases and register labels.
Explain transfer and waiting before hold; alternatives falsely confirm booking or disclose unrelated customer information.
Wait acknowledgement matches stated teaching example; other options cancel booking, request payment or announce all dishes unavailable.
Message and callback details are required handoff; alternatives discard details or present guesses as facts.
Question explicitly asks textbook basic behavior; quiet hangup after caller contrasts with interruption, force or abandoned hold.
Hidden ingredients in sauces/processed components justify checking seasoning; taste/appearance cannot establish absence.
Share avoided ingredients and verified conditions across workflow; alternatives omit or downplay the request.
Removal of visible egg does not address other ingredients/contact; other options falsely erase or narrow allergen presence.

results.semanticCheck: Safe tray movement and posture practice resolves tilting; alternatives deepen or accelerate unsafe movement.
Zero trap count can reflect position/device failure; other options infer success without checking effectiveness.
Changed raw material requires cut/heating assessment; alternatives retain unverified settings or omit finished-product checks.
Observe the specific time and measuring/instruction process; alternatives remove standards or make irrelevant changes.
Water/oil uniform mixing selects emulsifier; leavening, bleaching and color development do not answer that purpose.
Accessible non-punitive reporting addresses suppressed reports; alternatives disclose symptoms or discourage reporting.
Correct handling to store information rules; alternatives allow unlimited private storage or public disclosure.
Heat-sensitive materials require compatible method; alternatives increase heat, reshape damage or ignore materials.

results.semanticCheck: Unclear food restrictions require accurate confirmation help; nationality/nodding/photo assumptions are rejected.
Clean hands before gloves addresses contamination after cleaning; alternatives waive handwashing.
Safe equipment and food impact checks address abnormal steam; alternatives serve unchecked food or bypass safety.
Unit-price transcription error requires specification/price/input check; recount alone or removing price field fails to address it.
For fixed gross profit, smaller labor-hour denominator increases productivity; VI retains gross-profit definition and quality caveat.
Store service standard plus table progress/requests resolves sequencing; price/nationality/arbitrary halt do not.
Recall communication must follow affected distribution/use; alternatives stop at one store, guess exclusion or continue use.
Released water requires salting/draining standard; alternatives adjust seasoning/mixing/time while ignoring drainage.

results.semanticCheck: Conveyor washer washes large quantities of tableware; filleting/vacuum packing/probe measurement are unrelated functions.
Wine/sake fermentation category is consistent with explanation; alternatives distillation, soft drinks and milk do not match.
Physical glass and chemical detergent hazards require distinct controls; other options falsely equate, erase or require them.
Sterilizer does not replace cleaning; alternative purposes freezing/weight/type change do not address soil.
Brandy/whisky distillation category agrees with explanation; other categories deny distillation or alcohol.
Separate raw meat and ready-to-eat vegetable utensils prevents transfer; other choices cause holding/exposure/contamination.
Cut-and-mix equipment function matches key; cold storage/hot holding/UV are unrelated.
Question explicitly limits to textbook main ingredient; barley choice contrasts with exclusive rice/grape/potato; product-label caveat retained.
Separation controls spread before heating and heating controls microbes in food; alternatives remove washing or require joint storage.
Vacuum packaging does not waive specified storage temperature or time; other choices remove controls.

results.semanticCheck: Vegan animal-product avoidance includes egg/dairy; other choices mandate fish or exclude vegetables/alcohol only; individual conditions retained.
Dirty faucet contact can recontaminate hands; other choices dismiss contact or discuss unrelated expiry/color.
Close stable slow lift with legs contrasts with distant back-only lift, twisting and momentum; assistance caveat retained.
Halal basic permission meaning contrasts with uncooked/plant-only/salt-free; individual ingredient/process checks retained.
Add omitted cleaning location/frequency and implement; alternatives omit records/area or defer responsibility.
High load makes trolley unstable and obstructs forward view; alternatives claim unrelated weight/shelf-life/wheel changes.
Broth may contain meat/fish ingredients invisible in vegetable dish; alternatives infer from appearance or universal plant origin.
Question explicitly asks textbook example of locked fugu-waste container; no new regional rule asserted; local requirements caveat retained.
Dry floors assist slip prevention and hygiene; other choices incorrectly waive handwashing, heating or refrigeration.
Negative stem asks what to avoid: nationality-based assumption is key; remaining choices ask/verify actual customer conditions.

results.semanticCheck: Food-specific labels and usable dates determine priority; position/size/preference alone do not establish expiry.
Code scanning alone does not prove payment; amount/result check unique; other options double-charge or assume completion.
Question asks textbook lean inner-round characteristic; alternatives bones/offal/most-fat contradict the stated explanation.
Soiled outer packaging can spread via hands/handles; knife length, presentation color or pronunciation do not identify route.
Contract/terminal support determines acceptance; other choices assume all methods supported from card/app/device alone.
Thin slicing or small cuts match tougher outer-round cooking example; alternatives warming large raw block/add fat/freeze do not.
Question asks described basket-material pair, stainless/plastic; alternatives paper/textile/ceramic/cardboard contrast with explanation.
Explain escalation and report beyond authority; alternative choices promise unauthorized refund, abandon or ignore complaint.
Layered lean/fat matches two stated cuts; other choices deny fat, claim offal or equate all to tenderloin.
Toilet-cleaning gloves touching kitchen handle can spread contamination; other options waive replacement based on dryness/contact or later wiping.

before: Tôi sẽ nói lại với quản lý nhé.
Quản lý vắng mặt nên mọi việc đều không có hiệu lực.
Tôi xin chuyển lời đến quản lý.
Tôi sẽ xóa đặt bàn mà không báo cho ai.
after: 「店長に言っとくね」 — “Tôi sẽ nói lại với quản lý nhé.” (cách nói thân mật)
「店長がいないので全て無効です」 — “Quản lý vắng mặt nên mọi việc đều không có hiệu lực.”
「店長に申し伝えます」 — “Tôi xin chuyển lời đến quản lý.” (cách nói khiêm nhường, lịch sự)
「誰にも伝えず予約だけ消します」 — “Tôi sẽ xóa đặt bàn mà không báo cho ai.”
fixes.reason: The Japanese answer distinction is casual ittokune versus humble moushitsutaemasu. Bare Vietnamese translations could make the casual distractor sound like an acceptable polite customer response. Preserve the exact Japanese options alongside translations and explicitly identify the contrasting registers. Canonical Japanese, answer index and source hash remain unchanged.

dependencies.reason: Restaurant ledger has no reference to the modified VI translation file; the q231 reference binds unchanged Japanese content. No evidence rebinding or coverage promotion is justified.

limitations: This audit checks internal question and translation semantics, not independent certification of all source facts.
